Central London Office Market Watch 30 September 2026 Article
Welcome to your latest Central London office market watch, exploring insight from the City and West End office occupational markets
As is often the case during the summer months, leasing activity was quiet in August following a stronger July, although volumes remained ahead of the same month last year. A total of 557,416 sq ft was acquired across Central London, down 35% month on month (MoM) but 10% above August 2025, with the City accounting for 67% of space acquired.
